item.name: Delete a Shift Rate by external ID

request.description:
Delete a Shift Rate using its external ID, which is the custom ID provided when the shift rate is created. A ShiftRate can only be deleted if it is not currently associated with any active shift.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

item.name: Retrieve a Shift Rate by External ID

variable.description: (Required) The unique external identifier of the shift rate to retrieve.

request.description:
Retrieve details of a specific shift rate using its external ID. The response includes information such as the name, type, value, and unique identifier of the shift rate.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the shift rate to be updated.

request.description:
Update specific fields of an existing shift rate.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

Create a new shift rate with the specified attributes such as name, type, value, and a unique external identifier.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

request.description:

 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

response.name: Paginated list of shift rates retrieved successfully.

request.description:
Receives timesheet file metadata and generates a link to upload timesheet file. Please note that this endpoint supports EOR contracts as of now
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

response.name: Timesheet created successfully. Returns upload URL, upload form fields, and timesheet ID.
Bad request. Validation or business rule violation (e.g., non-EOR contract, invalid date range).
Unprocessable entity. Business logic constraint violation.

variable.description: (Required) ID of the timesheet to review

request.description:
Review a successfully submitted timesheet. Only PENDING_REVIEW timesheets can be reviewed, and all associated hours will be approved/rejected at once.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:write`

response.name: Timesheet reviewed successfully. Returns updated timesheet details with review status and review timestamp.
Unprocessable entity. Timesheet cannot be reviewed in its current state.

Retrieves a timesheet by ID, including its submission, review, and processing status. When expand=file_data is provided, the response also includes file-related details such as the file name, download URL.
 **Token scopes**: `time-tracking:read`

response.name: Timesheet retrieved successfully. Returns timesheet details including validation errors if applicable. When extend=file_data, also includes file_data object with file details and download URL.
